error.invalid_credentials: The email or password is not right.
error.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.

verify.title: Enter your code
verify.subtitle: Open your authenticator app and enter the six-digit code for Mustang.
verify.recovery_help: One of the codes you saved when you set up two-step sign-in. Each works once.
verify.use_app: Use the code from the app

enroll.title: Set up two-step sign-in
enroll.subtitle: Mustang asks for a code from your phone every time you sign in. It takes a minute.
enroll.step_scan: Scan this QR code with an authenticator app, such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password.
enroll.qr_alt: QR code to add Mustang to your authenticator app
enroll.manual: Can't scan it? Enter this key in the app instead:
enroll.step_code: Then enter the six-digit code the app shows.
enroll.load_error: Two-step sign-in could not be started.

codes.title: Save your recovery codes
codes.subtitle: If you lose your phone, each of these codes signs you in once. Keep them somewhere safe: they are not shown again.

error.mfa_invalid_code: That code is not right. Check the app and try again.
error.mfa_code_reused: That code was already used. Wait for the next one in the app.
error.mfa_too_many_attempts: Too many wrong codes. Wait a few minutes and try again.
error.mfa_already_enrolled: Two-step sign-in is already set up for this account. Ask an admin to reset it.
error.mfa_not_enrolled: Two-step sign-in is not set up yet. Sign in again to set it up.
error.unauthenticated: Your sign-in timed out. Sign in again.
error.generic: That did not work. Try again.

security.title: Two-step sign-in
security.description: You sign in with your password and a code from your authenticator app.
security.off_help: An admin reset it. You will set it up again the next time you sign in.
security.codes_low: Running low on recovery codes. Ask an admin to reset two-step sign-in to get new ones.
security.lost_phone: New or lost phone? An admin can reset two-step sign-in in Settings, Users. You then set it up again at your next sign-in.
security.load_error: Your two-step sign-in status could not be loaded.
